strategies.name: Baseline Sequential 8-Stage AllReduce
strategies.desc: Performs 8 sequential all_reduce operations (one initial + 7 dependent stages), each preceded by local bidiagonal coupling and followed by local decoupling operations. Total dispatch count: 8 all_reduce calls with full vector payload (224*1024 elements each). Represents the straightforward reference with maximum dispatch overhead but simplest correctness reasoning.

strategies.name: Fused Local Ops with AllReduce Batching
strategies.desc: Fuses all local coupling/decoupling arithmetic into pre-computed coefficient tensors, then performs 8 all_reduce dispatches on the full payload. Uses vector operations and in-place updates to minimize intermediate buffer allocations. Dispatch count remains 8, but reduces kernel launch overhead by batching all per-stage local operations into single vectorized tensor ops before/after each collective.

strategies.name: Reduce-Scatter + AllGather Decomposition
strategies.desc: Decomposes each all_reduce into reduce_scatter (each rank gets 1/W of result) followed by all_gather (broadcast partial results). Exploits the sharded structure: after reduce_scatter, each rank owns its shard and can apply bidiagonal coupling locally before all_gather. Dispatch count: 16 collectives (8 stages × 2 ops), but each moves only partial data, potentially hiding latency through smaller per-dispatch payloads.

strategies.name: Hierarchical Two-Level Reduction Pipeline
strategies.desc: Exploits multi-node topology (224 ranks across nodes) by structuring communication as intra-node reduce followed by inter-node reduce, then reverse broadcast. Each of 8 stages uses node-local collectives on smaller groups before global aggregation. Dispatch count: ~24 collectives (8 stages × 3-level hierarchy), trading more dispatches for bandwidth-optimized smaller transfers that match network topology.

strategies.name: Pipelined Overlapped Stage Execution
strategies.desc:
Splits the 224*1024 vector into independent chunks and pipelines stages across chunks, allowing stage i+1 to begin on chunk k while stage i processes chunk k+1. Uses asynchronous all_reduce dispatches with explicit wait barriers only at chunk boundaries. Dispatch count: 8×(number of chunks) all_reduce calls, overlapping communication and local computation to hide collective latency at the cost of increased total dispatch count.
